title: The effects of cholesterol-lowering drugs on neurocognitive function: systematic review and meta analysis.

answer.design_quote: Randomized controlled trials that evaluated neurocognitive events and neurocognitive function after using cholesterol-lowering drugs including statins, cholesterol absorption inhibitors, proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin 9 inhibitors were collected. The literature screening, data extraction and quality evaluation were carried out independently by two researchers, and the random effect model was used to pool the data.
answer.k_quote: A total of 42 studies with 150,405 subjects were included.
